readings: For each invoice (`Invoice_Line_Items.invoice_number`), take the average line product cost (`derived_product_cost`). Also take its total-cost-to-price ratio, found by dividing each line's `derived_total_cost` by its `product_price` and averaging those line ratios. Missing values are ignored. Average the invoice ratios across all invoices, and keep only the invoices whose ratio is above that average. As a single row, report the average over the kept invoices of (1) their average line product cost, (2) their ratio, and (3) how far their ratio exceeds the overall average ratio. Don't round.
queries:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost,
         AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / product_price) AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv
)
SELECT AVG(inv.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
       AVG(inv.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(inv.ratio) - overall.avg_ratio AS ratio_excess
FROM inv, overall
WHERE inv.ratio > overall.avg_ratio;
